ruleDefinitions.name: TeamViewer Remote Session
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of log files during a TeamViewer remote session

sequences.query: ((file_path = RGX("\\\\TeamViewer\\\\RemotePrinting\\\\tvprint\\\.db$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\\TeamViewer\\\\TVNetwork\\\.log$")) OR (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\TeamViewer.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\_Logfile\\\.log.*")))
